lead: Kylian Mbappé is a widely followed French association football player, born on 20 December 1998 in Paris.
As of 2026, he is 27 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has represented Real Madrid Club de Fútbol and has been recognised with Knight of the Legion of Honour and Best Young Player Award.
The sections that follow break down Kylian Mbappé's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Kylian Mbappé — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Kylian Mbappé was born on 20 December 1998 in Paris, and holds French nationality. He was given the name Kylian Mbappé Lottin at birth and is publicly known as Kylian Mbappé.
Public records name his father, Wilfrid Mbappé and his mother, Fayza Lamari. He is a sibling of Ethan Mbappé.
He is recorded as speaking French, Spanish and English.

sections.heading: Kylian Mbappé — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists association football player as his main occupation.
On the team sheet, Kylian has been associated with Real Madrid Club de Fútbol (from 2024). He plays as a forward.
He has taken part in 2018 FIFA World Cup, UEFA Euro 2020, 2022 FIFA World Cup, UEFA Euro 2024 and 2026 FIFA World Cup.
